RDB.portHint: Port RunnerDeck runs on, on this PC (default 8765).
RDB.autoHint: Connect to RunnerDeck when the world loads, once paired.
RDB.menuHint: Enter the pairing code, test and connect. Also via /rd in chat.
RDB.help: Open RunnerDeck → Settings → Foundry VTT → switch the bridge on and create a pairing code. Enter the 6-digit code here and press Connect. After that the module connects on its own.
RDB.needCode: Not paired yet: enter the pairing code from RunnerDeck.
RDB.errUnreachable: RunnerDeck is not reachable at {url}. Is RunnerDeck running on this PC and is the port right? (Foundry must run in a browser on the same PC.)
RDB.errOther: Another program than RunnerDeck answers at {url}. Check the port.
RDB.errDisabled: RunnerDeck is running but the Foundry bridge is off: switch it on in RunnerDeck under Settings → Foundry VTT.
RDB.errOrigin: RunnerDeck is paired with a different Foundry address. Remove the pairing in RunnerDeck and pair again.
RDB.errNoActor: Actor not found or no permission.
